import fs from 'node:fs'

const [profile, outDir] = process.argv.slice(2)
const KIT = '/data/claude/webkit/packages/webkit/docs/reviews/m2.7/battery-2-kit'
const pages = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${KIT}/pages.json`, 'utf8'))
const scores = fs.existsSync('/data/eval-m27b/compare/scores.json')
  ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/data/eval-m27b/compare/scores.json', 'utf8'))
  : {}
const dims = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${outDir}/dims.json`, 'utf8'))
const data = pages.map((p) => ({
  id: p.id,
  surface: p.surface,
  title: p.title,
  route: p.url_or_route,
  ref: `img/${p.id}--ref.webp`,
  ai: dims[p.id]?.ai ? `img/${p.id}--ai.webp` : null,
  refW: dims[p.id]?.ref?.[0],
  refH: dims[p.id]?.ref?.[1],
  aiW: dims[p.id]?.ai?.[0],
  aiH: dims[p.id]?.ai?.[1],
  score: scores[p.id]?.[profile] ?? null,
  page: scores[p.id]?.page ?? null,
  notes: scores[p.id]?.[`${profile}Notes`] ?? scores[p.id]?.notes ?? ''
}))
const isPhone = profile === 'iphone'
const name = isPhone ? 'iPhone 15' : 'Desktop 1440'
const other = isPhone ? 'desktop' : 'iPhone'
const tpl = fs.readFileSync('/data/eval-m27b/bin/compare.template.html', 'utf8')
const html = tpl
  .replaceAll('%%PROFILE_NAME%%', name)
  .replaceAll('%%OTHER%%', other)
  .replaceAll('%%COLW%%', isPhone ? '393' : '1440')
  .replace('%%DATA%%', JSON.stringify(data).replace(/</g, '\\u003c'))
fs.writeFileSync(`${outDir}/${profile}.html`, html)
console.log(`${outDir}/${profile}.html`, data.length, 'pages')
